subject: GCP go-to-market sync: Quantum Health x Redwood - joint pipeline & listing readiness
messages:
From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@quantumhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@quantumhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP co-sell kick-off: Quantum Health & Redwood — joint pipeline sync?

Hi Logan,

Quick intro — I'm Jamie (Partnerships, Quantum Health). Priya and I own our GCP marketplace listing and the field co-sell motion for our Care Optimization product. We're interested in doing a short joint pipeline review with Redwood so we can align GCP co-sell handoffs and make sure the listing is capture-ready.

High level agenda:
- Quick intros + roles from both sides
- Current GCP opportunities that could benefit from a co-sell motion (top 6)
- Listing readiness checklist & blockers
- Next steps and owners / timeline (mutual action plan)

Are you available for a 30 min sync on Thursday or Friday? Also, could you share any internal checklist you use for GCP listing readiness and a template for a mutual action plan — that'll help us prepare.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Jamie Liu
Senior Partnerships Manager
Quantum Health
jamie.liu@quantumhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

[attachment: QH_Opportunity_Summary_preview.pdf (attachment stub)]

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@quantumhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell kick-off: Quantum Health & Redwood — joint pipeline sync?

Hi Jamie — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the clear agenda. Thursday 10/22 10:00-10:30 PT or Friday 10/23 09:00-09:30 PT both work on my side — I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm which is best.

I've looped Vanessa (Partner Ops), Neha (Partner Manager), and Karthik (GCP PM) — they'll cover co-sell enablement, listing readiness, and the GCP integration checklist respectively.

Pre-reads I can share now:
- Redwood_GCP_Listing_Checklist.pdf (short checklist: listing metadata, billing flow, service account & OAuth verification, security/compliance artifacts)
- A blank Mutual Action Plan template (I attached a draft as Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_draft.xlsx)

Please attach a small CSV of the top opportunities you'd like us to review (name, stage, estimated ACV, GCP rep). If you can share HubSpot or a slide with priority accounts, we'll annotate owners and suggested co-sell plays during the call.

Goal for the meeting: leave with a drafted MAP and owners for next steps so we can route follow-ups to our field teams and enable a GCP co-sell motion for the prioritized deals.

Thanks — 
Logan Wright
Senior Partnerships, North America
Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
[attachment: Redwood_GCP_Listing_Checklist.pdf (attachment stub)]
[attachment: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_draft.xlsx (attachment stub)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell kick-off: Quantum Health & Redwood — joint pipeline sync?

Logan / team — looping in some suggested pre-work so the call is tactical.

Suggested pre-reads / asks for Quantum Health:
- Provide a CSV of the top 6-8 opportunities (as Logan requested) with forecast close dates and expected decision criteria
- Confirm whether the Quantum Health listing is currently in "draft" or "submitted" in GCP Marketplace (this affects PR and legal review windows)
- If available, share SOC2 attestation PDF or security questionnaire answers

On our side I'll volunteer to own the marketplace intake flow and timeline (I will: create the HubSpot co-sell pipeline tag, schedule GCP marketplace intake, and coordinate with our Legal/Compliance on the security artifacts). Karthik — can you confirm the typical lead time for listing approval (we should set expectations)?

I've attached a 1-page MAP example and added a suggested owner column; we'll convert call notes into this during the meeting.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
[attachment: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_draft.xlsx (updated by Vanessa) (attachment stub)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell kick-off: Quantum Health & Redwood — joint pipeline sync?

Thanks Vanessa — happy to own partner-facing coordination. I'll draft the HubSpot playbook snippet and assign the co-sell tags ahead of the meeting.

Quick note: I'll also request the customer's SOC2 or security questionnaire; if they can't share a full report we can accept a self-attestation for initial gating.

Neha Kapoor
Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@quantumhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@quantumhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell kick-off: Quantum Health & Redwood — joint pipeline sync?

Thanks everyone — Friday 10/23 09:00-09:30 PT works best for us. Calendar invite accepted.

Attaching the top opportunities CSV (QH_Redesign_Opps.csv) and a short one-pager that notes which deals have active GCP reps. I've also put the HubSpot deal link in the Doc — HubSpot id HS-92847 (we gave access to Logan).

A couple of clarifications before the call:
- Our listing status: draft — we haven't submitted yet because we are waiting on billing flow confirmation and the OAuth verification for the service account.
- We have SOC2 Type II report (available, will share after an NDA — happy to provide a self-attestation for the initial intake).

Looking forward to aligning and getting a MAP in place.

Best,
Jamie
